paraphrase: A universal conditional: under StrictForward, the link bridge, the time-sliced strong per se premise and the pure-act premise at each time, each mover of another at t has no potency in any respect at t. Four models of the local route premises with stipulated predicates: (1) strictly forward feedback A₀→B₁→A₂, where A is a first unmoved mover at t=1 and B at t=2, no being that ever moves is unmoved at every time, and FirstUnmovedMoverIsPureAct fails at t=1 because A has potency in another respect there; (2) a strictly forward successor chain with a first unmoved mover at each event's clock value, whose event relation has a cause for every event and is not well-founded; (3) the simultaneous alternating circle, where the slice regress premise and the slice first-mover conclusion fail at time 0; (4) a simultaneous chain 0→1→2 satisfying also the conditional regress premise, with 0 a first unmoved mover at time 0. Satisfiability controls only: not actual causal history, metaphysical possibility or explanatory sufficiency.
